props.name: src
props.description: The image. The lens shows this same file, scaled up.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How many times larger the lens shows it.

props.name: size
props.description: Lens diameter, or side for a square lens, in pixels.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Image aspect ratio (width / height). Reserves the space before the image loads.
